project_name: Carta dei Vini - Sommelier & Restaurant Catalog

theme_strategy.description: Inspired by fine Italian sommelier traditions, combining rich deep burgundy (#3B0B14, #58111A, #7A1C2C), soft vintage ivory (#FAF6EE, #F2EBD9), and brushed metallic antique gold (#D4AF37, #C5A059, #E6C687) trim.

scale.hero_title: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight font-bold
scale.meta_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-sans font-medium text-gold

layout_architecture.desktop: Left collapsible burgundy-gold sidebar with brand logo, main navigation links (Tutti i vini, Produttori, Regioni e Tipologie, Preferiti, Carta Stampabile, Backup & Export), staff user status & quick action button.
layout_architecture.mobile: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism + bottom navigation bar with icons and quick access to major sections.
layout_architecture.grid_system: Responsive Bento Grid for wines (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6`), with quick switch to structured compact table list view.
layout_architecture.padding: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) with gold accent borders (border border-[#C5A059]/30) and inner container padding to prevent visual collision.

key_features_design.tutti_i_vini: Filterable gallery grid & table list toggle. Features instant search bar (nome, produttore), filter badges (regione, tipologia, denominazione, annata), and price range display.
key_features_design.wine_card: High-impact card displaying label image thumbnail, wine name, producer, vintage (annata), denomination (DOCG/DOC/IGT badge), wine type (Rosso, Bianco, Rosato, Spumante, Passito badge), wine specs (vitigno, formato), price (Prezzo in Carta & Prezzo Acquisto for staff), favorite star button, quick edit & view detail sheet modal.
key_features_design.wine_detail_modal: Full-bleed detail overlay with label photo zoom, sommelier description notes, full metadata grid, price comparison margin, region map/badge, edit button, and delete confirmation dialog.
key_features_design.produttori_section: Alphabetical and grouped card display of all wineries/producers with bottle count badge, top wines, and quick filter filter trigger.
key_features_design.regioni_tipologie_section: Visual breakdown by Italian regions (Toscana, Piemonte, Veneto, Sicilia, etc.) and wine types with interactive stats and bottle counters.
key_features_design.preferiti_section: Restaurant curated top selections star collection shared among staff.
key_features_design.printable_carta: Clean, elegant printable menu layout designed for customer presentation with paper background (Ivory), high-contrast typography, zero staff purchase pricing displayed, grouped beautifully by Tipologia and Region.
key_features_design.backup_and_export: One-click CSV/Excel export, JSON data download with embedded/linked label assets, and restore payload dropzone.
key_features_design.auth_gate: Sommelier / Staff login screen with burgundy atmosphere, vintage gold emblem, input validation, and secure session state.

testing_requirements.rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, view toggles, cards, action items) MUST include exact data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application in Italian language with full backend API persistence using FastAPI and MongoDB or SQLite.
Implement the dark burgundy (#24060C / #3B0B14) & gold accent UI theme with optional ivory mode for the printable Carta dei Vini.
Ensure the design radiates Italian high-end gastronomy aesthetics: fine typography, elegant borders, gold badge indicators, smooth state transitions.
Never hide essential filters or actions; deliver instant real-time search & filtering.

Add sample realistic Italian wines (e.g., Barolo Monfortino, Amarone della Valpolicella, Brunello di Montalcino, Sassicaia, Franciacorta Annamaria Clementi, Vermentino di Gallura) so the app looks populated out of the box.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use text shadows on photo overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Add hover glows, gold outline highlight shifts, and smooth entrance transitions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Use lucide-react or phosphor icons only. Never use emoji characters for navigation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: Strict requirement: Every input, button, select, tab, and card must have a unique kebab-case data-testid.
